auditor: SECP Lead Systems & Kernel Forensic Engineer

findings.summary: Sphere and Torus primitives are polyhedral extrusions of 2D polygons rather than genuine curved B-Rep geometries.
findings.codeEvidence: createSphere extrudes a 16-segment circle into a 16-sided cylinder; createTorus extrudes an offset circle into a genus-0 prism.
findings.actionableRecommendation: Implement true quadric/revolution surfaces (spherical, toroidal) with exact UV parameterization and circular edge trims.

findings.summary: Boolean surface intersector only handles Plane-Plane, Plane-Cylinder, and Plane-Sphere pairs. Others fail-closed with UNSUPPORTED.
findings.codeEvidence: unsupportedCount is incremented for all other pairs, triggering BooleanEngine.execute to return status 'UNSUPPORTED'.
findings.actionableRecommendation: Expand BooleanIntersector to support Cylinder-Cylinder, Sphere-Sphere, and general quadric-quadric intersection algorithms.

findings.summary: Authentic Cox-de Boor knot span discovery and basis function evaluation implemented for curves and surfaces.
findings.codeEvidence: findKnotSpan performs binary search; evaluateBasisFunctions implements exact Cox-de Boor recurrence relation.
findings.actionableRecommendation: Integrate NurbsSurface geometry into BRepFace definitions to enable freeform B-Rep modeling.

findings.summary: Deterministic parametric dependency graph with topological sorting, transactional rollback, and PLM hash invalidation is fully verified (28/28 unit tests pass).
findings.codeEvidence: Topological sort validates acyclicity; deep backup snapshots allow transactional rollback; CanonicalEngineeringIdentity cascades hash changes to FEA/CFD/CAM.
findings.actionableRecommendation: Preserve existing regeneration engine as the sovereign architectural spine.

findings.summary: executeFillet and executeChamfer perform shallow object cloning with appended metadata tags without modifying B-Rep topology.
findings.actionableRecommendation: Develop topological edge fillet/chamfer operators that trim adjacent faces and insert cylindrical/planar blend surfaces.

findings.summary: Shell inner cavity uses a hardcoded 0.8 coordinate scale factor instead of genuine inward normal face offsetting.
findings.codeEvidence: x: v1.x * scale (where scale = 0.8), which distorts geometry not centered at the origin and ignores requested thickness.
findings.actionableRecommendation: Replace scaling with analytical face normal offsetting (v_in = v_out - thickness * face_normal).

findings.summary: STEP AP242 translator performs JSON.stringify and JSON.parse rather than ISO 10303-21 text parsing.
findings.codeEvidence: exportToStepPart21 returns JSON.stringify(model); importFromStepPart21 checks for '{' character.
findings.actionableRecommendation: Implement ISO 10303-21 standard clear text encoding and entity mapping.

findings.summary: OcctKernelAdapter exists in code, but opencascade.js is uninstalled; loader falls back to static mock with hardcoded outputs.
findings.codeEvidence: ls node_modules/opencascade.js returns 'No such file or directory'; createBrowserMockOcInstance returns static Mass=27000 mm3.
findings.actionableRecommendation: Do not treat OCCT as the primary kernel. Focus on native SECP kernel development; retain adapter for optional future selective WASM integration.
